about.description: USDX is a US-dollar-pegged stablecoin issued by Stable Inc., backed by a portfolio of tokenized US residential mortgages, real-estate-backed assets, and Mortgage-Backed Securities. Primarily Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac agency MBS (the same instruments held in size on the Federal Reserve's balance sheet). USDX maintains its peg via asset-backed collateralization (each USDX backed by ≥ $1 of underlying RWA), automated mint/redeem against USDC via app.trystable.co/swap, and Chainlink price feeds for underlying-asset valuations. Base USDX is non-rebasing. Holders can opt-in to stake USDX to earn yield generated by mortgage interest, MBS coupons, and real-estate cashflow in the reserve portfolio. Live on Solana (primary), Ethereum, Base, and Monad. Paired with USDC in DEX liquidity pools (e.g., USDX/USDC on Orca, Solana) to support arbitrage-driven peg stabilization. Reserves and on-chain contract addresses are published on the trystable.co reserves dashboard.
